summary: Learn USAID award administration, cost review, monitoring, and reporting through practical exercises. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Grant and cooperative agreement training prepares award, project, and finance staff to manage award conditions, costs, records, and reporting. Participants practise reviewing conditions, checking sample costs, mapping approvals, monitoring budget variances, and tracking procurement and performance evidence. They also create reporting and closeout checklists using sample scenarios and spreadsheet templates; exercises do not configure live systems or determine how requirements apply to a specific award.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who administer or support USAID-funded awards and need a practical foundation in award conditions, costs, documentation, and reporting.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Basic familiarity with project administration, budgets, or grant records is useful. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to a spreadsheet application if you want to complete the budget-tracking exercise digitally; check current award documents and applicable organizational procedures when applying course concepts at work.
